sources.name: Zefix — Central Business Name Index (Federal Commercial Registry)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Central index of all Swiss commercial-register entities. Public REST API confirmed live at /ZefixPublicREST/ (Swagger UI loads); also catalogued on i14y.admin.ch and opendata.swiss. Per-entity queries free; systematic bulk replication restricted by cantonal ToS.

sources.name: Zefix Public REST API
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (Swagger UI responds). Machine route for company lookups by name/UID, legal seat, legal form, and daily SOGC register mutations. The primary deterministic ingest route for CH.

sources.name: LINDAS Linked Data Service — Zefix dataset (SPARQL)
sources.verdict: Found via search: Zefix published as linked data on the federal LINDAS platform (SPARQL endpoint lindas.admin.ch). Not fetched directly; catalog entry confirmed in search results.

sources.name: UID Register (Federal Statistical Office enterprise ID register)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Public search with advanced filters (legal form, canton, status). BFS also offers a UID web service for registered users; public web search confirmed, API terms need registration.

sources.name: Cantonal commercial register offices (e.g. Handelsregisteramt Kanton Zürich)
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. Cantonal registers hold the authoritative excerpts/documents; Zefix federates the index. Listed for document-level retrieval; access varies by canton.

sources.name: opendata.swiss (federal open data portal, DCAT/CKAN)
sources.verdict: Real portal; hosts the Zefix dataset entry among others. Our fetcher got HTTP 403 (bot protection) but the portal and its DCAT catalog API are well documented; verify with proper user agent.

sources.name: FINMA — authorised institutions, persons and products (all licensee lists)
sources.verdict: URL corrected via search (old …persons-and-products path 404s). FINMA publishes downloadable Excel/PDF lists of all authorised banks, securities firms, fund management companies, managers of collective assets, insurers, and fintech licensees. Core tier-2 source; hint said partially harvested already.

sources.name: FINMA — list of fund management companies, managers of collective assets & fund representatives
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search (direct FINMA media asset). The AIFM-equivalent register for Switzerland (CISA licensees): fund managers, ManCos, representatives of foreign funds. Excel variant available from the lists page.

sources.name: FINMA — authorised banks and securities firms list
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via search (direct FINMA media asset, name/city/foreign-control columns). Companion Excel on the lists page.

sources.name: FINMA — SRO member search (AMLA-supervised financial intermediaries)
sources.verdict: URL verified via search. Searchable register of all financial intermediaries supervised via SROs (VQF, PolyReg etc.) — captures independent asset managers, trustees, payment/credit providers below FINMA direct licensing. Search requires 5+ characters (no full dump).

sources.name: FINMA — FinTech licence list (Art. 1b BA)
sources.verdict: Confirmed in search results as one of the downloadable FINMA lists. Switzerland has no MiCA register (non-EU); the FINMA fintech licence + SRO membership + DLT trading facility authorisations are the crypto licensee equivalents.

sources.name: Swiss National Bank data portal
sources.verdict: Portal exists but served a browser-not-supported page to our fetcher. data.snb.ch offers a documented REST API (JSON/CSV) for banking statistics, interest rates, balance sheets. API route real but needs a modern UA; mark for adapter testing.

sources.name: OAK BV — Occupational Pension Supervisory Commission
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Publishes the annual financial-situation report on all Swiss pension funds (coverage ratios, investment strategy aggregates), directives, and media releases. Aggregate LP-side intelligence; no per-fund public register with holdings.

sources.name: FAOA/RAB — Federal Audit Oversight Authority public register
sources.verdict: Register app loads (authority name confirmed; Angular-style app). Public register of all licensed audit firms and auditors — the deterministic source for the fund-auditor slice of the service graph.

sources.name: Swiss Emissions Trading Registry (BAFU)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED welcome page (official Swiss ETS registry, linked to EU ETS since 2020). Whether a public account-holder/participant list is downloadable was not confirmed — needs a deeper pass on the public reports section.

sources.name: eSHAB / SOGC — Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (JS app 'eSHAB'). Machine route confirmed: shab.ch/api/v1/… endpoints exist (e.g. /api/v1/archive/{id}/pdf), used by third parties incl. Moneyhouse. Carries commercial-register mutations, bankruptcies, debt-enforcement and liquidation notices — the CH insolvency signal source.

sources.name: Amtsblattportal (cantonal official gazettes platform)
sources.verdict: Same TAB publication platform as eSHAB, hosting cantonal official gazettes; API pattern shared with shab.ch. Not deeply fetched — verify tenant-specific API endpoints.

sources.name: Bundesblatt / Fedlex (Federal Gazette & law platform)
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED this session but Fedlex is the official federal publication platform with a documented SPARQL/linked-data endpoint. Secondary for entity work; primary for regulatory-change signals.

sources.name: Swiss Federal Supreme Court decisions database (BGer)
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. Public full-text decision search (insolvency, financial-market litigation). No structured API; HTML is parseable. Cantonal court publication varies.

sources.name: SIX Swiss Exchange — list of equity issuers
sources.verdict: Page verified but the issuer table renders client-side (nav-only to our fetcher). SIX statistics subpages offer CSV exports (e.g. closings, listed securities); the ad hoc news service and IFZ data need separate adapters. Treat as JS-rendered index with downloadable statistics files.

sources.name: SIX Exchange Regulation — official notices & ad hoc disclosures
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. SER publishes issuer official notices, sanctions decisions, and ad hoc disclosure feeds — the disclosure-signal route for listed Swiss issuers. Verify feed format in adapter work.

sources.name: BX Swiss — complete instrument list
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 12,693 instruments with explicit 'Complete instrument list (csv)' and 'Changes (45 days)' downloads. Clean deterministic source for the second Swiss exchange.

sources.name: Swiss Fund Data (SIX)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Database of all funds authorised for distribution in Switzerland, with provider search and market statistics. CAUTION: ToS explicitly prohibit systematic extraction/commercial exploitation — use for reference/verification only; the underlying authorisation facts come from FINMA lists instead.

sources.name: SECA — Swiss Private Equity & Corporate Finance Association member directory
sources.verdict: URL verified via search (old /Members/… path 404s). Member search covering GPs, corporate finance advisors, banks, law firms. Hint says already harvested — this is the current canonical URL.

sources.name: AMAS — Asset Management Association Switzerland member directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED homepage; a 'Member directory' link exists under About AMAS. Covers the institutional asset-management layer incl. private-markets managers.

sources.name: Swiss Bankers Association — member institutions
sources.verdict: URL verified via search (~263-300 member institutions incl. banks, securities firms, FMIs, bank auditors). Direct fetch of an older URL 404'd; use this current path.

sources.name: ABPS — Association of Swiss Private Banks member list
sources.verdict: URL surfaced in search results; not fetched. Small, high-value list of private banks (wealth/LP side).

sources.name: VSKB — Association of Swiss Cantonal Banks
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. 24 cantonal banks (major real-estate lenders and regional LPs); member list is public on the site per general knowledge — verify in adapter pass.

sources.name: SVV — Swiss Insurance Association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. ~70 members representing 95%+ of Swiss premiums; publishes 'Facts and figures' industry data. Member directory exists but detailed list not confirmed on homepage.

sources.name: ASIP — Swiss Pension Fund Association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED homepage (Schweizerischer Pensionskassenverband) but NO public member directory found on the site. LP-side coverage must come from OAK BV aggregates + cantonal BVG supervisory authorities instead.

sources.name: VQF — Financial Services Standards Association (largest SRO)
sources.verdict: Site real (verified via search; direct member-directory URL 404s). Member lookup routes through the FINMA SRO member search. Captures para-banking intermediaries: asset managers, trustees, credit providers.

sources.name: SIFEM — Swiss Investment Fund for Emerging Markets (DFI) portfolio
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Swiss DFI with a public Portfolio Explorer (sifem.ch/portfolio/): 107 funds & financial intermediaries, $1.14bn commitments. Direct LP-commitment data — rare and valuable.

sources.name: Switzerland Global Enterprise (S-GE) — investment & export promotion
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official investment-promotion agency; publishes market analyses and success stories (FDI signals). No entity register as such.

sources.name: simap.ch — Swiss public procurement platform
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Confederation + cantons + communes tender platform, redesigned July 2024 with archive. Manual search and saved-search subscriptions; no public API mentioned on page. Infrastructure/EPC deal signals.

sources.name: SAV/FSA — Swiss Bar Association attorney registry
sources.verdict: URL verified via search (canton-by-canton attorney registry; the /anwaltssuche.html path 404s). For the law-firm slice of the service graph; per-canton browsing, no bulk export.

sources.name: EXPERTsuisse — association of audit, tax and fiduciary experts
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. Membership directory of audit/fiduciary firms complements the FAOA register. Verify directory URL in adapter pass.

sources.name: RICS — find a firm/member directory (Switzerland filter)
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. Global RICS directory filterable to Switzerland for accredited valuers. Swiss-specific alternative: SIV (Schweizer Immobilienschätzer-Verband) — neither verified this session.

sources.name: SVIT — Swiss Real Estate Association
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. Property-management and brokerage member firms for the real-assets service layer. Verify member directory route.

sources.name: Crypto Valley Association — member directory
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. Zug crypto/tokenization ecosystem membership — maps the tokenized-RWA and digital-asset entity cluster. Verify directory depth.

sources.name: finews.com (English edition)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED (fetched, current items Aug 2026: UBS/CS integration, SNB results, personnel moves). Best English-language Swiss finance signal feed.

sources.name: finews.ch (German edition)
sources.verdict: Site real; the German edition's RSS route (/service/finews-rss) 404'd. Joomla ?format=feed pattern likely works per section but was NOT verified — harvest via section pages or test the pattern.

sources.name: Inside Paradeplatz
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED (fetched; hourly updates, Zurich banking scoops). High-signal for personnel and bank scandals; editorial tone — use for signals, never entity origination.

sources.name: Handelszeitung
sources.verdict: Leading German-language business weekly. /rss.xml 404'd and no feed URL found in searches — likely no public RSS since the Ringier relaunch. Scrape section pages or use newsletter.

sources.name: NZZ — Wirtschaft
sources.verdict: Feed URL confirmed by RSS directories but our fetch returned HTTP 402 — NZZ meters access. Headlines+links likely available to normal RSS readers; full text paywalled. Respect headline+link-only doctrine.

sources.name: Finanz und Wirtschaft (fuw.ch)
sources.verdict: Core Swiss markets daily. /feed entered a redirect loop for our fetcher; no working feed confirmed. Largely paywalled — headline monitoring via section pages.

sources.name: cash.ch
sources.verdict: Free Swiss markets news portal (Ringier). Guessed feed /rss/news 404'd; no feed URL verified. Section HTML is parseable.

sources.name: Le Temps — Économie
sources.verdict: Leading French-language daily. /rss returned 403 to our fetcher (bot protection); Le Temps historically offers per-section RSS — retest with proper UA. Paywalled full text.

sources.name: L'Agefi (agefi.com) — Swiss French financial daily
sources.verdict: The Romandie finance daily (Geneva asset-management coverage). RSS feeds exist per third-party directories but exact URLs not verified this session.

sources.name: SWI swissinfo.ch — business
sources.verdict: Public-service international outlet, 10 languages. /eng/rss returned HTTP 410 (feeds discontinued/moved); a business feed is referenced by directories but current URL unverified.

sources.name: Startupticker.ch
sources.verdict: THE Swiss startup/VC news channel (Innosuisse-backed; publishes the annual Swiss Venture Capital Report with SECA). About page claims an RSS feed but /en/rss, /en/rss-feeds and ?rss=true all failed — harvest the news archive HTML; it is cleanly structured with category tags (Financing, Exit).

sources.name: MoneyToday.ch
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED (fetched, ~20 current items). Swiss fintech/banking innovation coverage in German.

sources.name: Fintech News Switzerland
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED (fetched, current to Jul 31 2026). Fintech/digital-asset ecosystem signals.

sources.name: Crypto Valley Journal (CVJ.ch)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED (cvj.ch/en/feed 301s here; fetched, current items). Swiss crypto/tokenization coverage from Zug.

sources.name: Investrends.ch
sources.verdict: Swiss fund-industry news (German). Both /feed/ and /rss 404'd; no feed verified. Site itself not deeply fetched — verify existence and structure in adapter pass.

sources.name: Immoday.ch
sources.verdict: Swiss indirect-real-estate-investment news portal (funds, REITs-equivalent vehicles). Guessed feed URL 404'd; site not deeply verified this session.

sources.name: FINMA news & press releases
sources.verdict: FINMA RSS page confirmed via search (per-category feeds for press releases, enforcement, guidance). Individual feed URLs enumerated on that page — enforcement actions are high-value distressed/compliance signals.

sources.name: Swiss National Bank — press releases & RSS
sources.verdict: RSS service confirmed via search (SNB documents RSS 1.0 feeds incl. a dedicated press-release feed at snb.ch/en/services-events/digital-services/rss-calendar-feeds); feed URL taken from search result, not fetched directly.

sources.name: Federal administration news portal (admin.ch media releases — SIF, SECO, FDF)
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. Central media-release stream for finance ministry (FDF), SIF (financial-market policy) and SECO (insolvency law, sanctions). news.admin.ch historically offers per-office RSS — verify exact feed URLs in adapter pass.

sources.name: SIX Group — media releases
sources.verdict: NOT FETCHED. Exchange-operator news plus listing/delisting and index changes. Check for RSS in newsroom; ad hoc issuer news flows via the separate SIX ad hoc news service.

sources.name: Bilanz
sources.verdict: Swiss business magazine (rich-list, company features; same Ringier stable as Handelszeitung). No RSS verified; monthly cadence makes it a low-priority scrape.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong on Swiss GPs/LPs: Partners Group, LGT (Liechtenstein-adjacent), Unigestion, Capital Dynamics and the large pension-fund LP base; fund performance and fundraising for Swiss-domiciled and Swiss-managed vehicles.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: FINMA licensee lists (fund management companies, managers of collective assets), OAK BV pension-system reports and pension funds' own annual reports, SECA membership/reports, fund annual reports — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Swiss PE/VC deal and company coverage, valuations, service-provider mapping (law firms, banks on deals).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Zefix/SOGC register mutations (capital increases, new entities), SIX/SER issuer disclosures, press releases from firms and startupticker-style media — Zefix REST API and shab.ch API give us the same primary feed at $0.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Swiss startup/scaleup ecosystem mapping (works with local ecosystem partners; Swiss startup data also surfaced through swiss.tech and cantonal ecosystem portals).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Startupticker.ch news and the annual Swiss Venture Capital Report (startupticker + SECA), commercial-register incorporations via Zefix, company self-reporting — the SVCR PDF and startupticker archive are public.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Swiss startup funding rounds; investor profiles; weak on institutional/LP layer.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases, startupticker/fintechnews items, self-reported profiles — we ingest the same press layer via the verified RSS feeds above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The dominant Swiss company-information platform: 600k+ companies, register excerpts, management, SOGC monitoring, credit checks. B2B API offering.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Built almost entirely on public primary sources we can hit directly: Zefix/cantonal commercial registers and the SHAB API (search results confirm SHAB publications are retrieved via a Moneyhouse-operated API v2 arrangement). Do NOT scrape Moneyhouse; go to Zefix + shab.ch.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit risk, solvency and address data on Swiss companies; 30k+ business customers; strong on payment-behaviour data (proprietary).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Zefix/SOGC register and gazette data plus debt-enforcement publications; proprietary payment experience pools are not replicable and not needed for our use case.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Largest creditor-protection association; unique angle: covers sole traders and individuals not in the commercial register.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: SOGC bankruptcy/debt-enforcement publications, commercial register, plus member-contributed ledger experience (proprietary).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Authoritative fund reference data for CH-authorised funds, NAVs, documents; operated by SIX Financial Information.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: FINMA authorisation lists + fund providers' own filings. ToS ban systematic extraction — we use the FINMA source lists directly instead.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but not found / does not exist for Switzerland: (1) public UBO/beneficial-ownership register — Switzerland has none (the new transparency register under the 2026 federal act will NOT be public); (2) national insolvency-practitioner roll — bankruptcy administration is run by cantonal Konkursämter, no central public register of practitioners; (3) MiCA licensee register — CH is not in the EU; the equivalents are FINMA fintech licences, DLT trading-facility authorisations and SRO membership (all catalogued above); (4) EU ETS national accounts for CH — Switzerland runs its own linked Emissions Trading Registry (catalogued) rather than an EU ETS national account; a downloadable public participant list was not confirmed; (5) open bulk download of the full commercial register — Zefix API is per-query; cantonal ToS prohibit systematic replication for competing registries; (6) working RSS feeds for Handelszeitung, cash.ch, fuw.ch, investrends.ch and immoday.ch — none found (404s/redirect loops); startupticker claims an RSS feed in its about page but no working feed URL could be located; swissinfo's old /eng/rss returns 410; (7) ASIP pension-association public member directory — not published; (8) a national register of pension funds with per-fund investment data — OAK BV publishes only aggregates; per-fund data lives in individual annual reports; (9) a Swiss litigation-funding or royalty-fund register — no such register exists; those entities surface only via Zefix + SECA + press.
